practice.title: Take an Interview III: opinión y comparación
practice.intro: Hoy practica el lenguaje de comparación (*whereas, however, compared to, on the one hand… on the other…*) y de opinión matizada.

questions.q: Do you think it is better to specialize in one subject or to study a wide range of subjects?

segments.text: Do you think it is better to specialize in one subject or to study a wide range of subjects?

questions.model: I think specializing is better at university, because depth makes you valuable. However, a broad base helps you connect ideas. For example, my physics degree is specialized, but a course on ethics changed how I think about engineering decisions.
questions.hint: Postura → comparación o matiz (whereas/however) → ejemplo → cierre.

questions.q: Compare working alone and working in a team. Which do you prefer and why?

segments.text: Compare working alone and working in a team. Which do you prefer and why?

questions.model: I prefer teams for complex projects, because different skills complement each other. Working alone is faster for simple tasks. For instance, in a robotics project, my teammate handled the programming while I built the hardware, and we finished in half the time.
questions.hint: Postura → comparación o matiz (whereas/however) → ejemplo → cierre.

questions.q: Some people think that cities are better places to live than villages. What is your opinion?

segments.text: Some people think that cities are better places to live than villages. What is your opinion?

questions.model: I think cities offer more opportunities, such as jobs and education, whereas villages offer peace and community. Personally, I prefer a small city, since it combines both. For example, in my hometown I could walk to the library and still reach the mountains in thirty minutes.
questions.hint: Postura → comparación o matiz (whereas/however) → ejemplo → cierre.

questions.q: How has your opinion about studying changed since you were in high school?

segments.text: How has your opinion about studying changed since you were in high school?

questions.model: In high school I studied to pass exams, but now I study to understand. That shift happened when I realized that deep understanding lasts longer. For example, I used to memorize formulas, but now I derive them, and I remember them much better.
questions.hint: Postura → comparación o matiz (whereas/however) → ejemplo → cierre.

checklist: Usé al menos un conector de comparación (whereas, however)
Mantuve el ritmo sin pausas largas
Terminé con una frase de cierre
